GZero 1.5 adds change-point detection in breaking traces, a tab for fixed-gap blinking (I(t)) measurements and six more file formats, and fixes every problem found in a full review of the code.

**Windows download:** `GZero-v1.5-windows-x64.zip` below. Unzip it anywhere and double-click `GZero\GZero.exe`. You don't need Python. Keep the whole folder together; the exe doesn't work on its own. The user manual is in `GZero\docs\User_Manual.pdf`, and Help -> User manual (F1) opens it from inside the program. `selftest_report.txt` is the self-test of exactly this build.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the exe isn't signed: click "More info", then "Run anyway".

New in 1.5:
- **Change points** (new tab, manual 6.5): the rupture of every trace by the Chow test (Hamill et al. 2024), with one plateau conductance and one length per junction; blank traces are told apart by the slope before the break. The steps between flat conductance levels by PELT (Killick et al. 2012), so traces with two or more steps show up.
- **Blinking** (new tab, manual 9.9): fixed-gap I(t) measurements (Haiss et al. 2003, 2006). Blinks are found against a drifting baseline with two thresholds; you get the blink conductance, the lifetime of the junction (tau_on), the arrival time (tau_off), the blink rate and a histogram aligned on the blink starts. Works on whole recordings or on holds.
- **File formats** (manual 3.1): LabVIEW `.lvm`, Excel `.xlsx`, MATLAB `.mat` (also v7.3), NumPy `.npy` / `.npz`, HDF5 `.h5` / `.hdf5` and gzip-compressed text files, in Data & Traces, EGaIn and Thermopower.
- **Fixes:**
  - Text files whose header line contains a comma can be read.
  - Missing current samples and zero bias no longer turn into fake 100 G0 contacts.
  - The diode calibration no longer leaves NaN inputs unset.
  - The noise power of each hold no longer depends on the length of the first hold.
  - An old peak fit is dropped when the histogram changes.
  - Results are cleared when the data change, so old results can't be saved under a new name.
  - The plateau export works without a valid window.
  - The binned noise trend includes the largest point.
  - The 2D density histogram is divided by the bin area.
  - Very short recordings no longer stop trace detection.
  - The bell fit of the noise scan is much faster.
- **Documents:** the manual has new sections for change points, blinking and the file formats, and the methods note is now `GZero_methods.pdf` (1.3-1.5).

To run from source on any OS, see the README.
